# Korean lunar calendar

- Package: `korean-lunar-calendar@0.4.0` (MIT, Jinil Lee)
- Source: https://github.com/usingsky/korean_lunar_calendar_js
- Download: https://registry.npmjs.org/korean-lunar-calendar/-/korean-lunar-calendar-0.4.0.tgz
- The browser build is served locally so birthdays do not need to be sent to a calendar API.
- License: `korean-lunar-calendar.LICENSE`
- Package lunar range ends at 2050-11-18. Out-of-range values are rejected, never approximated.
